settings.profile.sot.title: Profiles on the sync host
settings.profile.sot.desc: What the host this device syncs with holds. Renaming or deleting one here changes it for every device.
settings.profile.sot.delete_blocked_curr: This device is syncing with it. Stop sync first.
settings.profile.sot.delete_blocked_atta: Devices are still attached. Stop sync on each of them first.
settings.profile.sot.delete_body: Every device loses this profile on the host. What each device holds locally stays. This cannot be undone.
settings.profile.sot.attached_none: Not deleted: a device was attached a moment ago. Try again.
settings.profile.current.title: Sync
settings.profile.current.none_what: Profile Sync keeps one profile — its hosts, settings, workspaces and tabs — the same on every device, through a host you choose.
settings.profile.current.none_how: This device is not syncing. Nothing leaves it until sync is set up.
settings.profile.current.pull_unconfirme: The hosts on the sync host changed after you confirmed the pull, so nothing was pulled and sync was stopped. Set it up again to see what the pull would remove now.
Sync stopped: the hosts on the sync host changed after you confirmed the pull. Nothing was pulled.
settings.profile.current.master_desc: The profile on the host that this device's master follows.
settings.profile.current.from_leader: Reported by the window that is syncing
settings.profile.current.stale: The window that was syncing is gone. What is shown here may be out of date.
settings.profile.current.blocked.endpoin: Nothing is syncing: the host's address changed. It was attached at {{was}} and is now {{now}}. Put the address back, or stop sync.
settings.profile.current.blocked.profile: Nothing is syncing: the profile is no longer on the host. What this device holds is untouched. Choose another profile with “Sync with another profile or host…” below, or stop sync to go on locally.
settings.profile.current.blocked.suspend: Sync is paused for a moment while a window sets it up.
settings.profile.current.blocked.host_id: Sync is paused: {{hosts}} connects to a daemon other than the one it is recorded as. Fix its address in Settings › Hosts, or remove it — sync resumes by itself.
Sync is paused: a host connects to a daemon other than the one it is recorded as (seen by the window that syncs). Fix its address in Settings › Hosts, or remove it — sync resumes by itself.
Sync is paused: {{hosts}} are the same daemon, so it cannot tell which is which. Remove one of them in Settings › Hosts — sync resumes by itself.
Sync is paused: two hosts on this device are the same daemon, so it cannot tell which is which. Remove one of them in Settings › Hosts — sync resumes by itself.
settings.profile.current.world.catching_: Catching up with another window that just switched profile.
settings.profile.current.world.junk_epoc: Sync is paused: this device's record of which profile is on screen is damaged. Switch profile once to repair it.
settings.profile.current.world.no_parked: Sync is paused: there is no master world on this device. Reload the app to repair it.
settings.profile.current.schema.sot-is-n: Nothing is written: the host holds a newer format than this version of Purdex understands. Update Purdex on this device.
settings.profile.current.schema.shape-ch: Nothing is written: the host holds a format this version of Purdex cannot place. Update Purdex on this device.
settings.profile.current.settings_waitin: Settings are waiting for workspaces, which is locked. A change of settings stays on this device until you decide which copy of workspaces to keep.
Settings are waiting for workspaces, which keeps failing to sync. A change of settings stays on this device until it gets through.
settings.profile.current.no_status_follo: Nothing known yet: waiting for the window that is syncing to report.
settings.profile.current.section.locked_: Locked: changed here and on the host
Locked: the host's copy was recreated
Locked: the host's copy cannot be used here
settings.profile.resolve.title: Locked sections
settings.profile.resolve.desc: A locked section syncs again once you decide which copy to keep. Each choice overwrites the other copy, so it is confirmed first.
settings.profile.resolve.why.conflict: This device and the sync host both changed it since they last agreed.
settings.profile.resolve.why.reset: The sync host's copy was recreated: its revision went backwards.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.del: The sync host deleted this section, and this device cannot be without it.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.mal: The sync host's copy is not in a form this version of Purdex can read.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.no_: The sync host's copy would leave this device with no host at all.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.rem: The sync host's copy would remove the host this device syncs through.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.cha: The sync host's copy would change the address, port or token of the host this device syncs through.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.rej: The sync host's copy holds settings this version of Purdex refuses.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.unk: This version of Purdex does not know this section.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.dup: The sync host's copy lists the same host twice.
The sync host's copy gives two hosts the same former id, so this device cannot tell which one it means.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.hos: Two hosts on this device are the same daemon, so this device cannot tell which one the sync host's copy means. Remove one of them.
settings.profile.resolve.why.invalid.unk: This device cannot apply the sync host's copy.
settings.profile.resolve.invalid_only: Only this device's copy can be kept.
settings.profile.resolve.undoes: “Keep this device's” also undoes what you changed here since.
settings.profile.resolve.changed: This changed while you were deciding. Look again before you choose.
settings.profile.resolve.sent: Sent. Waiting for the window that is syncing.
settings.profile.resolve.no_answer: No answer from the window that is syncing. Try again.
settings.profile.resolve.not_sent: Could not be sent. Try again.
settings.profile.resolve.auto_sync_off: Auto-sync is off: this takes effect when you turn it back on or press Sync now.
settings.profile.resolve.keep_local_body: The sync host's copy is replaced by this device's, and every other device syncing this profile receives it.
settings.profile.resolve.take_sot_body: This device's copy is replaced by the sync host's.
settings.profile.resolve.dialog_undoes: What is kept is the copy this device had when the conflict was found — what you changed here since is undone.
settings.profile.resolve.local_moved: This device's copy changed since the lock was taken; what is here now is what is kept.
settings.profile.resolve.sot_moved: The sync host's copy has changed again since this was shown.
settings.profile.current.auto_sync_desc: Sync changes as they happen. Off: only when you press Sync now. This device only.
settings.profile.current.sync_now_desc: Run one round of sync, from any window.
settings.profile.current.sync_asked_foll: Sync requested. The window that is syncing will run it.
settings.profile.current.stop_desc: Detach this device from the profile on the host.
settings.profile.current.stop_body: What this device holds stays exactly as it is, and so does the profile on the host. They just stop following each other.
settings.profile.current.problems_desc: A log, newest first. An entry here does not mean the problem is still there.
settings.profile.sot.stale_action: Nothing was sent: the list changed while you were deciding. Look again and retry.
settings.profile.sot.endpoint_changed: Nothing was sent: the host's address changed. Look at the list again and retry.
settings.profile.detach.not_told: This device has stopped syncing — but {{host}} could not be told ({{detail}}).
settings.profile.detach.consequence: The host may still list this device as attached to the profile, and a profile with a device attached cannot be deleted from any device. Try again when the host is reachable.
settings.profile.detach.retry_failed: Tried again just now: the host still could not be told.
settings.profile.detach.dismiss_hint: Stop reminding me. The host may keep listing this device until someone removes it there.
settings.profile.local.name_changed: This name was just changed to "{{name}}" in another window. Save keeps yours.
settings.profile.current.label.tabs_unse: Tabs · (a workspace not on this device yet)
settings.profile.current.label.tabs_unkn: Tabs · (workspace name not available right now)
settings.profile.detach.not_told_plain: This device has stopped syncing — but {{host}} was not told.
settings.profile.detach.endpoint_changed: {{host}} was at {{was}} when this device was attached and is at {{now}} now, so nothing is sent: the registration is on the machine at the old address.
Put the address back and try again, or remove the registration on that machine.
settings.profile.detach.host_gone: That host is no longer in this app (it was at {{was}}), so there is nowhere to send the request.
settings.profile.detach.host_gone_unknow: That host is no longer in this app, so there is nowhere to send the request.
settings.profile.detach.host_gone_how: Add the host again at that address and try again, or remove the registration on that machine.
settings.profile.detach.endpoint_unknown: This reminder was saved without the host's address, so it cannot be retried safely from here. Remove the registration on that machine.
settings.profile.detach.consequence_plai: Until it is removed there, that machine may still list this device as attached to the profile, and a profile with a device attached cannot be deleted from any device.
settings.profile.current.change: Sync with another profile or host…
settings.profile.current.change_desc: Runs the setup again from its first step. The first step stops the current sync.
settings.profile.wizard.title: Set up sync
settings.profile.wizard.refused.client_i: Sync cannot be set up in this browser session: it cannot keep this device's identity across a reload (storage is blocked or full). The host would see a new device every time and the old registrations could never be removed. Allow site storage — or leave private browsing — and try again.
settings.profile.wizard.refused.junk_epo: Sync cannot be set up right now: this device's record of which profile is on screen is damaged. Switch profile once to repair it, then come back.
settings.profile.wizard.refused.no_parke: Sync cannot be set up right now: this device has lost track of its master world, and nothing here can put it back. Reload the app — it repairs this when it starts — then come back.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.attached_: Another window has just started syncing this device. The setup is back at its first step: that sync has to be stopped first.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.stopped_e: The sync was stopped in another window. There is nothing left to stop here.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.host_gone: The host you chose is no longer in this app. Choose a host again.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.host_offl: The host you chose is not connected any more. Choose a host that is, or wait for it to come back.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.local_gon: The local profile you chose was deleted in another window. Choose again.
settings.profile.wizard.stop.what: This device is syncing now. Before it can sync with anything else, that sync is stopped — this is the first thing the setup does, and it happens when you press the button below.
settings.profile.wizard.stop.safe: Stopping changes nothing on this device and nothing in the profile on the host. If you close the setup after this step, the device simply stays not syncing.
settings.profile.wizard.stop.not_told: This device has stopped syncing — but the host could not be told, so it still lists this device as attached. The reminder below this setup keeps track of it and lets you try again. You can go on with the setup now.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.what: Choose the host that keeps the synced copy, and the profile on it that this device will follow.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.host_none: No host is connected right now. Sync needs a connected host: connect one, then come back to this step.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.empty: This host has no profile yet.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.new_hint: It is created on the host when you press the button below, and starts empty.
settings.profile.wizard.request.network: The host could not be reached.
settings.profile.wizard.request.timeout: The host did not answer in time.
settings.profile.wizard.request.aborted: The request was cancelled before the host answered.
settings.profile.wizard.request.contende: The host is busy with another change. Try again in a moment.
settings.profile.wizard.request.not_foun: This host does not offer Profile Sync — its daemon may need an update.
settings.profile.wizard.request.too_larg: The host refused the request as too large.
settings.profile.wizard.request.rejected: The host refused the request. Check the name and try again.
settings.profile.wizard.request.unauthor: The host refused this device's credentials. Check the host's token in its settings.
settings.profile.wizard.request.server: The host ran into an error of its own.
settings.profile.wizard.request.malforme: The host's answer could not be understood — its daemon may be a different version.
settings.profile.wizard.request.unknown_: That host is no longer in this app.
settings.profile.wizard.request.thrown: The request failed before it was sent.
settings.profile.wizard.local.what: A device syncs exactly one of its profiles: its master. Choose which profile of this device that should be.
settings.profile.wizard.local.keep: The master stays the master. Nothing on this device is moved.
settings.profile.wizard.local.move: “{{name}}” will BECOME the master — a move, not a copy. “{{master}}”, the master until now, is kept on this device as a local profile and stops being the one that syncs. This is done in the last step, and it is not undone if a later step fails.
settings.profile.wizard.local.catching_u: This window is catching up with a profile switch made in another window. The next step opens as soon as it has.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.what: The first time, one side has to win wherever both hold something. After that, changes flow both ways.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.push: Push — this device overwrites the profile on the host
settings.profile.wizard.direction.pull: Pull — the profile on the host overwrites this device
settings.profile.wizard.direction.pull_n: Pull is not offered: this profile has just been created and is empty.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.pull_e: Pull is not offered: this profile holds nothing yet.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.push_r: What “{{profile}}” holds on the host now will be REPLACED by this device's hosts, settings, workspaces and tabs — and every other device that follows it will receive that.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.pull_r: This will REPLACE the master on this device: {{workspaces}} workspaces and {{tabs}} tabs.
This will REPLACE the master on this device. What it holds cannot be counted right now.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.pull_a: This device's host list and settings are replaced too. Local profiles other than the master are not touched.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.save_f: First keep a copy of those workspaces and tabs as a local profile
settings.profile.wizard.direction.no_cop: No copy will be kept: those workspaces and tabs will be gone from this device.
settings.profile.wizard.run.summary: This is what will be done, in this order. Nothing has been done yet.
settings.profile.wizard.run.save: Keep a copy of the master as the local profile “{{name}}”
settings.profile.wizard.run.attach_push: Start syncing with “{{profile}}” on {{host}} — this device overwrites it
settings.profile.wizard.run.attach_pull: Start syncing with “{{profile}}” on {{host}} — it overwrites this device
settings.profile.wizard.run.done_push: This device now syncs with “{{profile}}” on {{host}}. Its content is on its way to the host.
settings.profile.wizard.run.done_pull: This device now syncs with “{{profile}}” on {{host}}. The host's content is on its way here.
settings.profile.wizard.now.stopped_here: The setup stopped here. Nothing after this step was attempted.
settings.profile.wizard.now.promoted: “{{name}}” is this device's master now, and the previous master is kept as a local profile. That stays as it is.
settings.profile.wizard.now.saved: The copy “{{name}}” was made and is kept.
settings.profile.wizard.now.nothing_chan: Nothing on this device was changed.
settings.profile.wizard.now.not_syncing: This device is not syncing, and nothing on it or on the host was replaced.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.master_a: Another window has started syncing this device, and a synced master cannot be swapped. Start over: the first step stops that sync.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.busy: Another operation on this device's tabs is in progress. Try again in a moment.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.unsettle: Another window just switched profile. Try again in a moment.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.supersed: Another window changed this device's profiles at the same moment, and its change won. Try again.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.not_foun: That local profile is no longer on this device. Start over and choose again.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.bad_name: The previous master could not be given a name. Start over.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.bad_epoc: This window was behind another one for a moment. Try again.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.write_fa: This device could not save the change — its storage may be full. Everything was put back.
settings.profile.wizard.promote.other: The master could not be changed.
settings.profile.wizard.save.unsettled: Another window just switched profile, so the master cannot be read this instant. Try again in a moment.
settings.profile.wizard.save.bad_name: The copy's name cannot be used. Start over and give it another.
settings.profile.wizard.save.bad_world: The master's workspaces and tabs could not be read, so no copy was made.
settings.profile.wizard.save.write_faile: This device could not save the copy — its storage may be full.
settings.profile.wizard.save.other: The copy could not be made.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.invalid_d: The direction was not understood. Start over and choose it again.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.client_id: This browser session can no longer keep this device's identity across a reload, so the host was not asked. Allow site storage and start over.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.unknown_h: The host was removed from this app while the setup was running. Start over and choose a host.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.invalid_p: The host handed out a profile id this app cannot use. Start over and choose another profile.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.supersede: Another window started or stopped a sync at the same moment, and its decision stands. Start over to see where things are.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.network: The host could not be reached, so this device was not registered with the profile.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.timeout: The host did not answer in time. This device may or may not be registered there; trying again is safe.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.aborted: The request was cancelled before the host answered. Trying again is safe.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.contended: The host is busy with another change to this profile. Try again in a moment.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.not_found: That profile is no longer on the host — it was deleted meanwhile. Start over and choose another.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.too_large: The host refused the registration as too large. Shorten this device's name and try again.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.rejected: The host refused the registration. Its daemon may be a different version.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.unauthori: The host refused this device's credentials. Check the host's token in its settings, then try again.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.server: The host ran into an error of its own while registering this device. Try again.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.malformed: The host's answer to the registration could not be understood. Its daemon may be a different version.
settings.profile.wizard.attach.other: Sync could not be started, for a reason this app has no words for. Try again.
settings.profile.wizard.toast.done_saved: Now syncing with “{{profile}}” on {{host}}. The workspaces and tabs this device had are kept as the local profile “{{name}}”.
settings.profile.wizard.toast.stopped_pr: Sync setup stopped while changing this device's master. Open Settings › Profile to see where things are.
settings.profile.wizard.toast.stopped_sa: Sync setup stopped while keeping a copy of the master. This device is not syncing. Open Settings › Profile to see where things are.
settings.profile.wizard.toast.stopped_at: Sync setup stopped while registering with the host. Open Settings › Profile to see where things are.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.profile_c: Another device changed this profile while you were setting up, so nothing was started. Choose the direction again — it now holds content, and a push would replace it.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.profile_e: Another device emptied this profile while you were setting up, so nothing was started. Choose the direction again.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.profile_g: This profile was deleted from the host while you were setting up, so nothing was started. Choose a profile again.
settings.profile.wizard.run.checking: Checking with the host that the profile is still as you saw it…
settings.profile.wizard.run.check_failed: Nothing was started: the host could not be asked whether the profile is still as you saw it.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.create_unkno: It is not known whether the profile was created: the host did not answer, and its list could not be read either. Press the button again — the host is asked what it holds first, and nothing is created twice.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.create_not_c: The host was then asked, and no such profile is there. Pressing the button again creates it.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.create_same_: It is not known whether the profile was created, and the host now holds an empty profile of that name that may or may not be it. Choose it from the list above if it is yours, or give the new one another name.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.create_ma: It is not known whether your profile was created — the host did not answer. A new, empty profile of that name is on the host now, marked in the list: it may be the one, or another device may have created it in the same moment. Choose it if it is yours, or give the new profile another name.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.pull_refu: Nothing was started: the pull cannot be made right now. Why is said below — you can still push.
settings.profile.wizard.notice.removes_c: Nothing was started: the hosts this pull would remove from this device are not the ones you were shown. Look at the list below again, then continue.
settings.profile.wizard.request.endpoint: The host's address changed while it was being asked.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.checking: Checking which hosts this pull would remove from this device…
settings.profile.wizard.pull.removes: It also REMOVES these hosts from this device — the profile has no entry for them:
settings.profile.wizard.pull.check_faile: Which hosts this pull would remove could not be checked.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.master_unve: Pulling needs this device to have confirmed which daemon this host is, at its current address — it has not yet. Wait until the host is connected, or push instead.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.master_mism: The daemon at this host's address is not the one the host is recorded as, so its host list cannot be matched safely. Fix the host's address in Settings › Hosts, or push instead.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.master_unma: This profile on the sync host has no entry for the host you sync through ({{name}}) — a pull would remove it, so it cannot be pulled through it.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.duplicate_h: This profile lists one daemon twice in its host list, so a pull cannot tell its entries apart. Push to replace it, or fix it from another device.
settings.profile.wizard.pull.host_identi: Two hosts on this device are the same daemon. Remove one of them in Settings › Hosts before pulling.
settings.profile.wizard.direction.host_m: {{name}}: the daemon this host connects to now is not the one it is recorded as. Once sync starts it will pause until you fix this host's address or remove it.
settings.profile.wizard.sot.maybe_yours: may be the one you just created
file_tree.set_project_path: Set the project path to show the file tree
file_tree.session_not_implemented: Session file tree not yet implemented (needs daemon cwd API)
